title: Capability Map
description: Declares which canonical capabilities a provider implements. Unknown capability keys are rejected so the registry stays a reliable source of truth for the runtime, CLI and future desktop UI.

paymentInitiation.description: Provider can accept a new payment request.

statusQuery.description: Provider supports querying the status of a previously created payment.

callbacks.description: Provider will deliver asynchronous callback(s) to a caller-supplied URL.

reversal.description: Provider models reversal of a completed payment. Optional for v0.1 (state modeled, endpoint optional).

refund.description: Provider models refunding a completed payment. Optional for v0.1 (state modeled, endpoint optional).
